create_mxfp4_moe_weights: create MXFP4 quantized MoE layer weights with packed w13 and w2 parameters and group-wise scales
apply_activation_silu_swigluoai: apply silu or swigluoai activation function to combine w1 and w3 expert gate outputs
dequant_mxfp4_to_fp8: dequantize packed MXFP4 weights to FP8 format with BF16 scales for pre-unpacking before inference
run_mxfp4_moe_forward: run MXFP4 MoE forward pass with expert selection, GEMM emulation, and expert output aggregation
get_fused_moe_quant_config: get the fused MoE quantization config for OCP MX modular MoE with MXFP4 or MXFP8 dtypes
